newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso cuts losses, ends sharply off.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso cuts losses, ends sharply off.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso contract closed a hefty 6.5 centavos weaker on Wednesday at 7.7850/7.7800 per dollar, but had partly recovered from an earlier battering in a panic-stricken market, traders said.
"Every one took fright...heavy demand by foreigners paved the way for panic buying by local banks," said a trader.

The benchmark 48-hour contract and its 24-hour counterpart were meanwhile 7.85 and 8.00 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.7900/7.8075 and 7.7900/7.8050 per dollar and still trading, although recovered slightly from early lows.
